title: CIFAR-10 digital ReLU source for matched IBM OM recovery
hypothesis: A pretrained bias-free 3072-256-10 digital ReLU network supplies a nontrivial common source for the CIFAR-10 crossbar study.
motivation: Extend the MNIST HWA-versus-recovery comparison using a source trained without physical noise or faults.

arms.description: 100-epoch digital pretraining; validation CE selects one frozen source.

completion_criteria: One complete native digital run and selected checkpoint.
Selected validation accuracy at least 45 percent before hardware runs.
Disjoint 45000/5000 split and official test reserved until checkpoint selection.
analysis_plan: Record validation-selected epoch, official test accuracy and loss.
Pin source checkpoint content hash and preprocessing for all hardware arms.
